347 days from 1291-01-27.  
1291 is a common year (not divisible by 4).  
Jan 27 + 347 days:  
Jan has 31 days → days left in Jan = 4 (27 to 31 inclusive is 5 days, but we start counting from the next day: 28 Jan is day 1 of the 347).  
Better: 347 days after Jan 27.  
Days remaining in Jan after Jan 27: 31 - 27 = 4 days.  
347 - 4 = 343 days left after Jan.  
Feb 1291 has 28 days → 343 - 28 = 315 left after Feb.  
Mar 31 → 315 - 31 = 284.  
Apr 30 → 284 - 30 = 254.  
May 31 → 254 - 31 = 223.  
Jun 30 → 223 - 30 = 193.  
Jul 31 → 193 - 31 = 162.  
Aug 31 → 162 - 31 = 131.  
Sep 30 → 131 - 30 = 101.  
Oct 31 → 101 - 31 = 70.  
Nov 30 → 70 - 30 = 40.  
Dec 31 → 40 - 31 = 9 days into next year.  
So date is 1292-01-09.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1292-01-09
